text:
Mia K: quick q — for the internal edge adapter, can we standardize on gRPC+protobuf for service-to-service model routing and use a lightweight HTTP/JSON shim for browser clients? thinking about quotas, telemetry, and rollout UX
Dan R: i'd vote proto first for internal. better typing, smaller payloads for embeddings/meta. but browser SDK needs http, yes
Sasha P: +1 proto internally. main concern: gateway CPU tax for transcoding + lost trace/span fidelity. we need a clear header contract for quota and route hints (so the routing policy can short-circuit)
Oliver T: what if we do negotiation at the edge: prefer grpc in the mesh, detect grpc-web or json and only transcode when required. keeps internal fast. also can attach quota tags early
Mia K: that feels reasonable. can we keep telemetry intact when we transcode? i.e., preserve traceparent, and add x-rd-route / x-rd-tenant headers before any decode
Dan R: yeah preserve traceparent. also add a routing tag that encodes model variant and priority, e.g. x-rd-route: models/llama-70b:low-prio. quota service can use that to map to buckets
Sasha P: caveat: some clients will call through CDNs with header rewrites. we'll need signed header propagation or a small auth token so gateway trusts incoming tags
Oliver T: prototype idea — grpc-web passthrough + header enrichment. envoy config fragment we tried in spike:

```
# envoy snippet
filters:
- name: envoy.filters.http.grpc_web
- name: envoy.filters.http.router
route:
  request_headers_to_add:
  - header:
      key: x-rd-route
      value: "%REPLACED_ROUTE%"
```

Oliver T: envoy can do jwt verification then set x-rd-tenant and x-rd-sig. if sig missing, gateway falls back to safe-default route and rate limits heavily
Jamal: i'll spin up a small spike: grpc-web passthrough -> header enrichment -> quota tagging -> emit telemetry sample. goal: show latency/CPU delta vs always-transcode
Mia K: sweet. can you also add a canary plan? want UX in console to show "proto vs http traffic split" and a per-route quota burn chart
Jamal: yup — plan: (1) prototype; (2) run small canary for 2 tenants; (3) add dashboard signals (token cost, p50/p95 latency, quota burn)
Mia K: rough timeline?
Jamal: prototype by EOW, canary next week, dashboard PR after canary signals look stable
Dan R: one more ops note — telemetry needs to include "decoded_model_size_bytes" when transcoding so billing/optimize can surface when clients cause big expansions
Sasha P: agree. add a regression alert for cpu per-req > threshold during canary
deploy-bot: canary job started for "edge-grpc-web-passthrough" on ring-3 — 6 instances
Mia K: thanks all. next sync once Jamal posts spike results. :thumbsup:
